name: Watanabe Tsugumi
source:
A first-year student at Yaesaka, and Takahiro's younger sister. Belongs to a swimming club, in the same class as Kanako, and an active and spirited girl. But slightly pitiful for being a target of both Hatsune and Iguchi. She is the most popular girl among the staff. 

Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Atlach-Nacha]AliceSoftWikia[/url]
